summary: United Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing an October 13, 2026 settlement with Liquidia Technologies resolving patent litigation over Yutrepia and Tyvaso DPI, plus related trade-secret actions. Liquidia pays UT $330.4 million aggregate, including a $185 million initial payment triggering dismissals with prejudice within ten days; UT pays Liquidia $10.0 million. Patents at issue included UT's 327 patent expiring February 3, 2042 and 782 patent expiring May 14, 2027, and Liquidia's 494 patent expiring May 5, 2037. This is a routine legal settlement, not a special situation requiring deal terms.
